title: Chintzy. Dim.
text: Chintzy. Dim.. These were just a little too low quality for me. They worked as described with the remote but the lights are so small that the whole thing isn't very bright and I had to double it up or it was just too thin and dull and spread out. I would not recommend this unless you were coiling it or using it in a clump or a basket or something. Trying to stretch it around a doorway like I was going to do was too much for this thin little strand.
